findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 163 requests to 40 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 5.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 2.2 MB (39%) came from third-party domains, 1.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (120 requests).

26 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), contextweb.com (PulsePoint, advertising), creativecdn.com (RTB House, advertising), deepintent.com (DeepIntent, advertising), dotomi.com (Conversant, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising).
86 cookies were set by third-party domains (110 cookies in total).

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 63 requests were blocked. The page still made 163 requests to 40 third-party domains, including 28 tracking services in our list.
